outputs: dot K_i from the BKM metric differential
dot O_ij / Omega_ij from the polar-correlation differential on a nonsingular polar stratum
dot M_ij for M_ij=K_j-O_ij^T K_i O_ij

Nontrivial nonmetricity circulation must live in the traceless/shear sector.

geometric_nonautonomy.theorem: There is no autonomous first-order source law dot G = F(G,P) on the current visible metric/connection/holonomy variables alone, because two positive hidden completions with the same current G and same source P have different connection/holonomy response jets.

No second independent state-independent linear conservation relation was found. This does not exclude nonlinear, state-dependent, higher-order, or continuum identities.
